lines.text: Saturn. We are inside the rings - billions of ice chunks, from grains to house-sized blocks. The ground is ice and it is slick.
Ice falls from the ring plane. Watch the shadows above you, and skate carefully - you will not stop on a dime.
Ring debris is coming down. Watch the shadows, astronaut, and skate clear.
Fuel Cells recovered. That is power for the whole trip home.
Cells stowed. The rings are mostly water ice - and yes, extremely thin for their width.
The ground is ice: start slowing long before you need to stop.
Falling ice chunks flash right before impact. Sidestep, do not outrun.
On ice, tap the direction keys in pulses instead of holding them.
